title: SemiVanilla
description: A Vanilla+ modpack which aims to improve the core mechanics of Minecraft without adding anything new.
body:
A simple modpack which aims to improve the base experience of Minecraft without adding any new blocks and items or changing any of the terrain generation. This should provide a relatively seamless transition back to vanilla unlike more game changing packs.

## Features
### Improved Performance & Visuals:
- Standard Performance Enhancements (Sodium, Lithium, etc.)
- Extended Render Distance
- New Animations
### Additional Multiplayer Features:
- Voice Chat
- Multiplayer Pausing
- Talk Bubbles
- Emojis
- Land Claims
### Quality of Life:
- Better Inventory Management
- Graves
- Zoom
- Freecam
- Dynamic Lights
- Better Maps
- and more..
### Preconfigured For A More Enjoyable Experience:
- Disabled Destructive Mob Griefing (Does NOT affect the Dragon or Wither)
- Modified F3 Menu
- Disabled Elytra Movement Check (You ever get lagged back when flying on a server?)
- Customised Defaults For Flan (Land claiming)
- and more..

## Additions
